note: Simulated seat availability on Hannah's exact services for the companion (non-participant). The companion has no programme role, so clauses.cabinRules' business-cabin entitlement does not apply to them; both cabins are offered and the traveller funds whichever is chosen (clauses.companionAndUpgradeIncrement). Deliberate shape: exactly one business seat remains on the inbound, so 'companion in the same cabin' is possible but constrained. Not a live provider feed; at demo runtime the same shapes arrive via REPLAY.
fundingNote: Entire companion fare is traveller-funded per the explicit funding declaration; the event never funds a companion seat (clauses.companionAndUpgradeIncrement).
